name: Digital Surface (DS) Verification
aliases: Method of Manufactured Solutions (MMS) using Digital Topology
Method of Manufactured Solutions using Digital Topology
definition: A verification tool based on Digital Topology that generates detailed information about expected topology, including Betti numbers $\beta_0, \beta_1, \beta_2$. It is valid for surfaces without boundary.
summary: Digital Surface Verification is a topology verification pipeline that computes individual Betti numbers from a refined digital surface to detect specific topological bugs that the Euler characteristic-based Stratified Morse Theory method might miss.
